references.phrase: upper bound of A in S
references.context: Element u of S such that every a in A satisfies a<=u.
An upper bound no greater than any other upper bound, if one exists.
Hypothesis excludes empty A and sets without an upper bound, without imposing total order.

references.disposition: Order-theoretic completeness here is not restricted to fields or real-number models.

review_rationale: Reviewed Dedekind completeness of ordered set as supremum existence for each nonempty upper-bounded subset; neither empty-set supremum nor unbounded-set supremum required.
